title: Replication of the 5-year (2021-08..2026-09) cell results on 2020-01..2021-07 Binance futures data
prespec: repl/PRESPEC.json (written before any pre-2021 result was computed)

method.question: Does the 5-year (2021-08-01..2026-09-30) per-cell gross direction (house exits, v4 normal sizing) replicate on 2020-01-01..2021-08-01 Binance USDT-M futures bars (data/pre2021)?
method.data: data/pre2021 (Binance USD-M monthly klines, 5m/15m/1h/4h native, 30m = resample of 5m as research/entry_study/final_signals.py), 6 coins BTC ETH SOL DOGE LTC BCH (XRP present but not in the 5y universe: excluded)
method.signals: core: locked sweep_lib.compute_signals via research/entry_study/final_signals.load_bars + signal_arrays (read-only import); DS: research/deepseek200/lib_c.entries with BTC context (read-only import); long wins on bars with both sides (as fyds_rerun / paperbot dssig)
method.window: signal bar time in [2020-01-01, 2021-08-01) and past sweep_lib.warmup_bars(tf) (max 300 bars, 30 days) of each coin series; exits may run into 2021-08 (bars to 2021-08-31)
method.exits_costs: identical to the 5y verified run: next-bar open + 0.02% slippage, stop 2 x ATR14 of the signal bar, paper v3 ROE ladder (profiles._scan), v4 'normal' sizing (config.v3_settings, $5,000; unsized signals dropped), taker 0.05% x2, slippage 0.02% x2, funding 0.01%/8h constant
method.metrics: gross R = side*(exit_raw/raw-1)/stop_frac (liquidations excluded, as v3agg); net R = v4n_R; mean and week-clustered t (cluster = ts // 7 days, as v3agg.ct)
method.expected_sign: sign of the 5y verified gross R in lens/fiveyear/verify3/agg_cells.csv

replication_rules.bh_replication: nominal and BH q <= 0.05 on the one-sided p in the 5y direction, BH over the 23 primary cells
replication_rules.inconclusive: otherwise; read together with the power column (expected t if the true effect equals the 5y estimate)

secondary: all other cells of these strategies and all core-36 x 5 tf / DS-44 x 4 tf cells for a global rank-agreement check (Spearman of 5y gross t vs pre gross t, cells with n>=200 in both)
long/short split (2020-21 was a bull market)
real-funding net R sensitivity from data/orderflow funding
5m-resolution exits for F16_FIB382/500@15m on the recent 5 years (and on pre2021), N23_HA_ST@4h on pre2021

headline: None of the 4 BH-positive 5y cells replicates on 2020-01..2021-07 Binance futures data (F16_FIB382@15m +0.010R t 0.69, F16_FIB500@15m +0.015R t 1.21, N23_HA_ST@4h -0.113R t -1.60 n 133, N20_EMA9_CHOP@5m flip-adjusted 0.000); most BH-negative cells do (direction content: 12 of 18 BH-replicate, 2 nominal). F6_VWAP_CROSS@15m is the only positive AI-timeframe cell that replicates (gross +0.018 t 2.72, direction +0.011 t 2.58). No cell is net positive. F16@15m significance survives 5m-resolution exits on 2021-26 (t 3.89->4.49, 3.31->4.06).
proves: The 5y positive direction cells are not confirmed out of sample in time (selection used 2021-08..2026-09 only); flip-adjusted direction content of all four is <= ~0 in 2020-21.
Anti-edges (N17_KC_RSI 15m/30m/1h, F15_ASIA_SWEEP 15m/1h, F11_PO3 30m/1h, F17_Z 4h, F11 raid family in direction content) persist across regimes; N17 also on spot data.
No rule cell is net positive even at the lower 2020-21 cost in R (wider stops).
F16@15m 5y significance is not a bar-resolution artefact (5m exits raise t).
does_not_prove: That F16 is wrong: pre sample = 25% of the 5y coin-days; power for t>=1.5 was ~0.62; gross difference z -1.0/-0.5 (direction content -1.85/-1.43).
Regime: 2020-21 was a strong bull market with ~1.5x volatility; the house ladder earned on both sides (core 15m flip +0.024R), and 4h sizing admitted only 7.5% of signals (N23 133 rows, all in 2020).
Anything about an AI's ability to add edge (only rule signals with house exits were tested).

DeepSeek definitions had seen this period once before with their PREREG exits (deepseek200 'pre' split); house exits on it are new. Core 36 period-3 signals were used in research/entry_study, not in the AI selection.
Funding is the constant 0.01%/8h (real funding: net R +0.001..+0.014 better); no mark-price data (liquidation on last price); no 1m history (5m is the finest resolution).

recommendations.F16_FIB382 (15m, 1h): keep + flag: evidence is one period and one exit (DeepSeek PREREG exits give negative gross in all three periods); remove 'verified direction edge' wording
recommendations.N23_HA_ST (4h; 15m/30m/1h): keep + flag: drop the '4h core edge' rationale (sized-subset 4h contradicted in 2020; all-signal 4h ~+0.02 in both periods; net +0.007 with 5m exits)
recommendations.N20_EMA9_CHOP (5m): do not use the 5m result as evidence (flip-adjusted 0, spot -0.006); stays reserve
recommendations.F6_VWAP_CROSS: keep (only positive cell whose direction replicates under BH; still net -0.12R pre, -0.17R 5y)
recommendations.N18_VWMA_MACD (15m): flag (5y +0.012 survives neither the period nor the spot-data check)
recommendations.N25_DST_CCI: flag 15m toward exclusion (no support in any data set; direction content -0.027 t -1.92); 1h keep
recommendations.V39_ALL (15m): flag; consider dropping from wave 2 (direction content -0.026 t -1.70, spot -0.006)
recommendations.N02_ST_KST (15m): flag (rule-account side of the Supertrend cluster anyway)
recommendations.anti-edges N17_KC_RSI, F15_ASIA_SWEEP, F: keep excluded; flipping them gains only +0.02..+0.06R direction, below cost
recommendations.F15_ORB (15m): keep excluded; its direction flips with the regime (5y -0.052, 2020-21 +0.055)
